docs.title: Welcome to Rhys' Alright Minecraft.
docs.text: A modpack for magic and engineering. Check features for a "how to" for certain mods. Check why? for important info.

docs.title: Download the modpack.
docs.text:
You should download the version that corresponds with the Minecraft Launcher you use. - Curseforge Edition - Modrinth Edition - Standalone Edition "Standalone Version" can be used with more open launchers such as my personal favourite: Prism Launcher. 

Current Ver: 2.0.1

docs.title: What can you do?
docs.text:
This is a modpack for engineers and magicians to come together and create. (I made this modpack solely for create mod, but magic is included as a gateway drug)

These mods have been configured to create a balanced experience.

Mods are in Bold. Clicking them will send you to the mod page. Specific Mod Documentations are below the mod names. They are also Clickable.

docs.title: Performance Enchancements
docs.text:
• Entity Culling
    • Disabled entities not currently visible on the screen.
  • Ferrite Core
    • Optimises Memory Usage.
  • Immediately Fast
    • Changes how minecraft loads stuff.
  • Lithium
    • TODO
  • ModernFix
    • TODO
  • Sodium and Sodium Extra
    • Reworks Minecraft Render Pipeline + Extra Configuration
  • BadOptimizations
    • Reworks Minecraft logic unrelated to Rendering.
  • AttributeFix
    • Fixes unecessary and optimises Minecraft attrbutes. 
Modpack was designed with 16GB DDR4, RTX3060ti, Intel i7 10th Gen.

Despite these performance enhancements, minecraft performance stil varies on PCs significantly. Below is a list of Tips and Tricks to help with lower end PCs.

docs.title: R.A.M. allocations
docs.text: Make sure to allocation at least 4GB of RAM to the Minecraft Instance. Follow your Minecraft Launcher guide on how to achieve this.

docs.title: Render Distance
docs.text: Has a significant impact on Minecraft performance- heavily relies on single-core CPU performance. Lower = Higher Performance.

docs.title: Shaders
docs.text: Less intensive shaders come included: Sildurs Vibrant Shaders or Potato Shaders. Use "k" to toggle on/off.

docs.title: Particle Effects
docs.text: Pariticles can be reduced and disabled using Sodium Extra in Video Settings.

docs.title: Why R.A.M?
docs.text: Why Rhys' Alright Minecraft?

docs.title: Custom Configs
docs.text: I went through all this trouble so make a well-balanced modpack with things I personally enjoy from other modpacks. In order to make this work, however, I needed to manually configure many mods in order for them to work in cohesion with one another. This resulted in a pretty alright modpack which I enjoy playing, and I wanted to share it with others.

docs.title: Do I make money?
docs.text: no. This is a hobby project. As a student, I don't have the resources to maintain this relatively unimportant project for mass consumption. I share this project with friends for a server I host, and thats it. I will maintain it as I deem necessary. Nevertheless, I hope you enjoy this modpack as much as I do. I've spent far too much effort making this, but it was made with ♥.
